approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Offline reproductions show that same-line RFI roles and Submittal statuses are lost, while compact workflow filenames absorb those labels into the identifier.
Recognize only an existing exact role or status immediately after an exact identifier; do not infer authority, approval precedence or semantic relationships.
Reuse the existing identifier normalizer and role/status allowlists; add no dependency or model call.
Synthetic text, Email Subject/body and filename fixtures now keep exact IDs separate from allowlisted same-line metadata; compact references reuse the same parser and descriptive titles stay neutral.
646 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline with 105 requirements, 15 schemas and a 368-file bundle manifest; no customer document, external request or paid call was used.
title: Parse same-line workflow metadata
objective: Keep exact same-line RFI role and Submittal status metadata separate from the workflow identifier across text, email and filename fallback without broad keyword inference.
